sourceReview.method: Read all 40 source slide XML text entries and visually compared PowerPoint-rendered original slides 2, 25 and 28
sourceReview.slide25: Confidential and medical data may need restricted access; the deck distinguishes FAIR practice from fully opening every data set and asks that at least the existence of restricted data be visible.
sourceReview.slide28: The deck separates technical publication of a complete machine-readable data set on an accessible platform from legal conditions that allow resharing and reuse, with a suitable license.

draftQuestion.question: 按照 ZBW 2025 年这份课件，公开研究数据在技术发布和法律许可方面分别需要满足什么条件？对不能完全公开的敏感数据，课件建议保留哪一层最低限度的可见性？
draftQuestion.expectedAnswer: 技术上，把完整数据集以机器可读格式放在易访问的平台，并优先存入有 DOI 的仓储以便引用。法律上，采用允许再分享和充分复用的条件，例如合适的开放许可。机密或医疗数据可能需要限制访问；即使限制访问，至少应让别人知道该数据存在。
